question: In 2025, which Indian female athlete set a new national record in the 3000 m steeplechase event?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parul Chaudhary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Parul Chaudhary** is an Indian middle and long-distance runner known for her achievements in various track events.
 
• In **2025**, she set a new **national record** in the **3000 m steeplechase event**, showcasing her exceptional talent and determination in athletics.
 
• The **steeplechase** is a highly challenging track and field event that includes hurdles and water jumps, requiring speed, endurance, and technical proficiency.
 
• Parul Chaudhary has consistently performed well in domestic and international competitions, earning recognition as one of India's top athletes in middle-distance running.
 
• Her achievements have inspired young athletes across India and have highlighted the country's growing presence in track and field sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **3000 m Steeplechase:**

 
 
• The 3000 m steeplechase is a distance running event that incorporates barriers and water jumps.
 
• It is considered one of the most demanding events in athletics due to the combination of running and jumping skills required.
 
• The event originated from horse racing steeplechases and was adapted for human competitors in the 19th century.
 
• Internationally, the event is governed by the **World Athletics**, which sets the rules and standards for competition.
 
 
 
• **Parul Chaudhary’s Background:**
 
 
• Parul hails from **Uttar Pradesh**, India, and began her career as a runner specializing in middle and long-distance events.
 
• Her training and dedication have earned her a place among India's elite athletes, representing the country in various international tournaments.
 
• Parul has worked under the guidance of experienced coaches and has participated in numerous national and international meets.
 
 
 
• **India’s Presence in Athletics:**
 
 
• India has been steadily improving in track and field events, with athletes like Parul Chaudhary achieving success in global competitions.
 
• Organizations like the **Athletics Federation of India (AFI)** are actively working to promote and support track and field sports in the country.
 
• Athletes are provided access to advanced facilities, coaching, and funding to help them compete internationally.
 
 
 
• **Other Prominent Athletes:**
 
 
• **Jyothi Yarraji:** An Indian hurdler specializing in the 100 m hurdles event; she has set national records in her domain.
 
• **Hima Das:** Known as the "Dhing Express," she is an Indian sprinter who gained fame for her performances in 400 m races, including winning a gold medal at the IAAF World U20 Championships.
 
• **Annu Rani:** A javelin thrower who holds the national record in the women's javelin event and has represented India in multiple global competitions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Steeplechase Records:**

 
 
• The world record for the women's 3000 m steeplechase event is held by **Beatrice Chepkoech** of Kenya, set in **2018** with a time of **8:44.32**.
 
• India continues to make progress in steeplechase events, with athletes like Parul Chaudhary setting national benchmarks.
 
 
 
• **Training for Steeplechase:**
 
 
• Steeplechase athletes require a combination of endurance, speed, and agility training.
 
• Specialized coaching focuses on improving hurdle technique and water jump efficiency.
 
• Indian athletes have access to state-of-the-art facilities and international exposure to enhance their performance.
